raw_segments.text: Moured under the trees of Charleville Mall, Father Conmey saw a turf barge, a tow horse
with pendant head, a barge man with a hat of dirty straw-seeded omitships, smoking and
staring at a branch of poplar above him.
It was idyllic, and Father Conmey reflected on the providence of the Creator who had made
turf to be in bogs whence men might dig it out and bring it to town and hamlet to make
fires in the houses of poor people.
